text: The movement from scarce human labor to abundant agent labor is not a quantitative extension of the neoclassical picture but a change in its binding constraint: when capacity is abundant, reputation is what remains scarce, and coordination organizes around it.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, From Neoclassical to Computative Labor: Foundations for a Testable Theory of Reputation Governance in the Agent Economy (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6890879
